admission.justification: Deriving from prerequisite IDs and current master-row states prevents a separately stored or manually edited wave plan from lying about which unfinished work blocks the next task.

applicability: The current derived waves of an ordinary master’s explicitly listed task population.
conditions: waitsFor and authoritative master-row task states are the inputs; waves are computed rather than persisted.
Tasks in work precede ready tasks; a waiting task follows its latest unfinished prerequisite.
statement: Master waves are derived rather than stored from waitsFor and authoritative task-row states, placing work first, ready tasks next and waiting tasks after their latest unfinished prerequisite.
